entries.23ad21aee83c9d3d: This business centers on the warehouse business, providing warehousing and handling, domestic land transport, international cargo handling and logistics facility leasing services. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥74,167 million (up 6.9% year on year), accounting for most of the consolidated operating revenue of ¥80,028 million. Operating revenue including internal operating revenue between segments was ¥74,186 million, and segment profit was ¥5,342 million (up 16.9% year on year). The securities report explains that storage fees, warehouse handling fees, land transport fees and international cargo handling fees increased due to higher utilization of logistics facilities newly opened in the previous fiscal year, the start of new transactions and expanded transactions with existing customers. As of March 31, 2026, the group’s storage area was 547,549 m², calculated as the total of 633,601 m² (owned area of 438,875 m² and leased warehouse area of 194,725 m²) less 86,052 m² of warehouse rental area, which is mainly logistics rental area. Separately, the securities report states that the overseas storage area was 28,983 m². The main subsidiaries carrying out the business are Yasuda Works (ownership of voting rights 62.5%), which handles warehouse handling; Hokkai Yasuda Soko, which operates a warehouse business in Hokkaido; Yasuda Unyu, which is engaged in land transport; Fuyo Air Cargo, which is engaged in international cargo handling; Nihon Business Logistics, which provides logistics management services; Yasuda Medical Logistics, which handles warehouse handling and storage management; and Yasuda Logi Pharma, which is engaged in pharmaceutical logistics. Overseas, the group has subsidiaries in China (Shanghai), Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore and India. In the “Status of Affiliated Companies” section of the securities report, consolidated subsidiaries other than one real estate business company are classified under this business.

entries.e0de1adf71b62969: Following Yokohama, this is a warehouse base in Tokyo. As of March 31, 2026, the securities report's status of facilities lists the Shibaura Office in the Tokyo area as a warehouse for the logistics business.
entries.e1339a6a49fb1d5c: Yasuda Logistics Corporation, together with its 23 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], operates the Logistics Business centered on warehousing, and the Real Estate Business centered on office building leasing in the Tokyo and Yokohama areas ([[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] for the fiscal year ended March 2026). Of the 23 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 company, Yasuda Estate Service, is in the Real Estate Business, and the remaining 22 are in the Logistics Business.
entries.e1d4b14665682a2f: Real estate leasing of office buildings and other properties
entries.e37194c766bcc5be: This was the event in which the segment of the market on which it is listed changed from the First Section to the Prime Market.
entries.e6dbea77fe625db1: It restored the company name, which had been changed to Taiyo Warehouse Co., Ltd. in March 1949, to Yasuda Warehouse Co., Ltd. in October 1954.
entries.e834bac5eccb112b: This business leases out logistics facilities; the securities report lists it as one of the services of the logistics business in its description of reportable segments.
entries.e839fe299a940351: This is the event in which a subsidiary responsible for logistics management services was added. The securities report states that the company entrusts IT kitting operations, packaging testing and packaging material procurement operations, and logistics management service operations to it.
entries.eb7a19670f1a340c: Changed the company name to Yasuda Warehouse Co., Ltd.
entries.ebc5a01761257f63: This is the event by which the head office came to be located in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The securities report states that after this, the head office was also relocated in July 1991 (Yasuda No. 8 Building) and in December 2020 (29th floor of msb Tamachi Tamachi Station Tower N).
entries.ef8359183c6f84c1: Through the "Logistics Business" and "Real Estate Business" [[term:segment|reporting segments]], it earns operating revenue from service fees for warehousing storage and cargo handling, transport, and other services, and from rent for buildings and other properties.
entries.efe72dec7fc95ca8: The Logistics Business is a service that performs cargo storage, cargo handling, transport, and other work based on contracts with customers.
entries.f13848c224fde153: In October 2013, it established Yasuda Medical Logistics Co., Ltd.
entries.f1cc2af40a09bd38: In November 1972, it established the current Yasuda Transport Co., Ltd. In July of the same year, it opened the Tokyo Port Office.
entries.f40cf6564db69eb5: Operating revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥80,028 million (up 6.5% from the previous fiscal year), and operating revenue from external customers was ¥74,167 million for the Logistics Business (up 6.9%) and ¥5,860 million for the Real Estate Business (up 2.0%).
entries.febd71998470be26: This is the event in which a subsidiary responsible for pharmaceutical logistics and a land transport company in Yawata City, Kyoto Prefecture, were added.
entries.ff6523d9c8252a8b: This business arranges cargo transport to and from overseas, among other services. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, handled volume was 1,007,864 tons (up 10.3% year on year). In Japan, the business is handled by Fuyo Air Cargo, an international cargo handling company; overseas, subsidiaries in Shanghai, Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore and India run international cargo handling businesses locally. The amount for this category is not separately disclosed in the securities report, so only quantities are shown.
